patterns.note: Content is presented in a single-column, centered layout with generous vertical spacing, emphasizing individual sections.
A distinctive dot-matrix display font is used for the hero heading, contrasted with an elegant serif for quotes and a clean sans-serif for body text.
A high-contrast dark theme dominates, featuring a deep black background, light text, and a subtle, bright green accent for interactive elements.

Sections and their internal elements (text, images) reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling. The main header also transforms from a full navigation bar to a minimalist sticky nameplate on scroll.
Each content block is treated as a distinct section, separated by significant vertical whitespace and introduced by large, bold headings.

technique_notes: The site employs a stark dark mode aesthetic with a pure black background and crisp white text, creating a high-contrast, focused viewing experience.

Scroll-triggered animations are used extensively to introduce content. As the user scrolls, text blocks and image cards animate into view with a gentle upward slide and fade, creating a sense of progressive disclosure.

The hero section features a canvas-based animation that renders the main heading as a dynamic dot-matrix display, which then subtly disappears or transforms as the user scrolls past the initial viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, technical-style hero heading (~6x body) with a distinct, elegant serif for quotes (~1.5x body) and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the animated dot-matrix text for the hero heading, which creates a unique blend of technicality and artistry. This, combined with the stark black background and minimalist layout, gives the site a highly sophisticated and almost artistic portfolio feel, rather than a typical marketing site.
